name: ergouzi-media-mcp
description: Codex plugin that exposes Ergouzi media predictions through MCP tools.

interface.shortDescription: Manage Ergouzi media tasks through MCP.
interface.longDescription: A local MCP adapter for Ergouzi media models. It exposes model listing, prediction lifecycle, cancellation, and downloads while keeping local file resolution on the client machine.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use ergouzi-media-mcp to manage media predictions.
